broaderDbIntegrationAttempt.reason: DB-backed API fixtures attempted the unconfigured local PostgreSQL default and failed authentication for user Xerxus.
broaderDbIntegrationAttempt.whyNoRetry: Those tests create and mutate fixtures. R21 allows read-only live-DB evidence and zero canonical/edge/alias writes, so production credentials were not supplied to a mutating test suite.

citationHarness.reason: No external network is allowed and NEW1 holds HEAVY_BOX; R21 instead ran the pure shared citation contract regressions and bounded read-only database evidence.
